description: This Java interface defines a logging node (LogNode) for a flexible, chainable logging system in an Android application. It specifies a method for outputting log data, supporting customization and chaining of logging behaviors.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system node that outputs log data and can be chained with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log entry with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable. Designed to be implemented by concrete classes to handle logging logic.
